title: 2.10 Which ones?
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Choose between two groups with ones (Which ones do you want? The red ones. / I want the green ones.), next to A1's one (Which one? The blue one.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.10 These and Those: A1 asks Which one? and answers The blue one.; A1+ 2.10 adds the plural ones for more than one thing (Which ones do you want? The red ones.). Each cast member holds the group they want while the other color stays beside them: Sofia red shoes (black beside her), Ana green apples (red), Diego white cups (black). Luis holds one blue book, so his line keeps A1's one (Which one do you want? The blue one.) next to the plural.
prerequisite: A1 2.10 Which one? The blue one.; A1 5.x I want, he wants; A1 7.3 shoes; A1 5.x apples; A1 5.14 cup; A1 2.3 book; A1 colors.
speaking_outcome: Say ones like 'wunz', linked to the color (the RED ones). Do not require native-like speed.
